use_cases: Landing page hero sections featuring dynamic image grids
Product or class showcases with randomized visual presentation
Portfolio-style hero sections for creative websites
E-commerce category pages with visual interest
Event or course landing pages with image galleries
ai_summary: A hero section component featuring a dynamic grid of images that shuffle randomly using Framer Motion animations. The component includes a text section with heading, description, and call-to-action button alongside a responsive 2x2 image grid. Designed for landing pages that benefit from visual interest through randomized image presentation.
